scope: Manually authored intended continuations, frozen before evaluating either context variant. No real user text or statistical sampling. Previous visible words are supplied conditionally; hook acquisition is not implemented.

rules.hint: Two consecutive uniquely dictionary-recognized alphabetic words of length >=2 in the same language; unknown, mixed and ambiguous words clear the hint.
rules.acceptance: Any newly wrong protected continuation rejects automatic integration; gains never cancel those failures. Design/challenge are reported separately; neither is independent population validation.
